description:
## Ultimea 1.4.4 (build 495, ARM64)

- AMOLED theme with light text, controls and icons, adapted from hxreborn.
- Remove the Explorer/Community tab with consistent tab selection and navigation.
- Preserve Bluetooth connection methods, device controls and all native libraries other than the theme/navigation edits in `libapp.so`.

In Morphe Manager, enable pre-releases for this source, refresh Sources, and repatch the original ARM64 app with both Ultimea patches. Install using your existing Manager signing key to preserve app data.

Build, regression tests and stock-APK patching passed. Physical startup, appearance and soundbar connection/reconnection still need testing.

Includes GPL-3.0-only work by [hxreborn](https://github.com/hxreborn/morphe-patches/tree/83839f596c9c7d8555c97809c34c2daabde03ec7); copyright and license notices are retained.
